# wikihow.tech

> A comprehensive technical how-to platform covering software tutorials, hardware setup, gaming strategies, and digital tools across Mac, Windows, iOS, and web platforms.

wikihow.tech provides step-by-step guides for technology users ranging from system configuration and security to creative software applications and gaming. The site serves both casual users seeking to optimize their devices and technical enthusiasts looking for detailed installation and modding tutorials.

## Key Topics

- how-to guides
- step-by-step tutorials
- Mac system settings
- iPhone/iOS
- YouTube
- Android
- security & malware protection
- Excel formulas
- game modding
- live streaming
- Adobe Photoshop
- AutoCAD
- hardware installation
- accessibility settings
- dark theme customization

## Operating Systems & Device Setup

- [How to Change Scrolling Speed on a Mac: 11 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.tech/Special:Randomizer): Guide to adjusting Mac mouse and trackpad scrolling speed via System Preferences
- [How to Protect Your Linux Desktop from Malware: 12 Steps - wikiHow Tech](https://www.wikihow.tech/Protect-Your-Linux-Desktop-from-Malware): Security guide for protecting Linux desktops using firewalls and access controls
- [How to Add Home and Today Screen Widgets on iPhone: 11 Steps](https://www.wikihow.tech/Add-Home-and-Today-Screen-Widgets-on-iPhone): iOS guide for adding and customizing home screen widgets on iPhone devices
- [How to Enable or Disable Dark Theme on Perplexity's Comet Browser on Windows](https://www.wikihow.tech/Enable-or-Disable-Dark-Theme-on-Perplexity%27s-Comet-Browser-on-Windows): Guide for toggling dark theme on Perplexity's Comet AI browser on Windows
